title: Architect‘s Legacy
description: Restoring the blocks that Mojang never added
body:
# Architect’s Legacy (Beta)

Completes Minecraft’s **block families** by adding the **missing stairs, slabs, and walls** — in pure vanilla style, with no custom textures and no gameplay changes.

Built for builders who want **consistent, complete block** sets without breaking the vanilla look.

## Features:

- Adds **~100 new blocks** in total

- Adds **missing stairs, slabs, and walls** for many existing Minecraft block families

- All blocks are craftable **just like vanilla**:
  - Via the **Crafting Table**
  - And via the **Stonecutter**

- Focuses on **completing** vanilla sets, not adding new styles

- Uses **100% vanilla textures** for a seamless look

- Perfect for **builders, architects, and detail-focused builds**

## Included in the Beta:

- Stone, Andesite, Diorite, Granite (including variants)

- Deepslate

- Blackstone

- Basalt

- Sandstone (including variants)

- Nether Bricks (including variants)

- End blocks

- Quartz

- Calcite

- Dripstone

- Amethyst

> ⚠️ This is a **Beta version** — more block families and variants are planned for future updates.

## Beta Notice

This release is a **Beta**:

- The current features are stable

- More block families will be added over time

- custom textures and variants will be added
